mentions.name: GuruRoam
mentions.description: A mobile-first place discovery companion that de-noises the user's environment, providing personalized, repeatable one-stop information about places with live updates to support quick decisions.
mentions.problem: The builders are passionate travelers with 30k km under their wheels who wanted consistent information across the many places they find themselves at.
mentions.source_excerpt: Place discovery companion that de-noises your environment. Repeatable, one-stop-shop for information, personalized. Quick to decision. Updates live (best on mobile).

evidence.value: Place discovery companion that de-noises your environment. Repeatable, one-stop-shop for information, personalized. Quick to decision. Updates live (best on mobile).
